seo.title: AITS Fleet Program | Recurring Truck Wash Contracts for Fleets
seo.description: The AITS Fleet Program offers recurring truck wash contracts with digital wash records and one consolidated monthly invoice for the entire fleet.

hero.title: From individual washes to recurring fleet contracts.
hero.lead: Simple pricing. Better economics at fleet scale.
hero.imageAlt: Front of a hand-painted Indian goods truck with a decorated cabin

journey.title: How a fleet wash is recorded and billed

benefits.title: Fleet Visibility
benefits.text: Wash history, records, and fleet analytics

benefits.title: Less Operational Friction
benefits.text: Reduced driver involvement and standardized process

items.title: Fleet Commitment
items.text: Minimum monthly wash commitment of 30 trucks · Fixed price per truck per wash

items.title: Digital Wash Record
items.text: Every wash captures: Vehicle ID · Date · Time · Location · Wash Type · Amount

items.title: Monthly Billing
items.text: One consolidated invoice for the entire fleet · No per-driver payment friction

pricing.title: Proposed / Indicative Pricing
pricing.hiddenText: Fleet pricing is shared on request, based on fleet size and wash frequency.

cta.title: Make a fleet inquiry
cta.text: Tell us about your fleet and AITS will get back to you.
